description: CE migration adds nullable tenants.suspended_at (timestamptz) and tenants.suspended_reason (text) with CHECK (both null, or suspended_at set with reason IN ('tenant_cancelled')); hasColumn-guarded like other tenants alters
Shared helper module in @alga-psa/shared exposes isTenantSuspended(knex, tenantId) as a single tenants PK lookup
isTenantSuspended fails open: any flag-read error logs a warning and returns false (never blocks active tenants)
Shared helper suspendTenant(knex, tenantId, reason) stamps suspended_at/suspended_reason only when currently null (idempotent) and returns whether it suspended
Shared helper resumeTenant(knex, tenantId, reason) clears suspended_at/suspended_reason only where the stored reason matches (preserves future manual suspensions)
New Temporal activity suspendTenantBackgroundActivity(tenantId) stamps the flag via suspendTenant with reason 'tenant_cancelled'; idempotent; errors contained (never strands deletion)

tenantDeletionWorkflow invokes suspendTenantBackgroundActivity immediately after suspendTenantEmailIngestion, guarded by patched('tenant-deletion-suspend-tenant-v1'), with new step marker 'suspending_tenant_activity'
New Temporal activity resumeTenantBackgroundActivity(tenantId) clears the flag via resumeTenant('tenant_cancelled'); query failures propagate so Temporal retries
handleRollback invokes resumeTenantBackgroundActivity after resumeTenantEmailIngestion, guarded by patched('tenant-deletion-resume-tenant-v1'), wrapped so rollback never fails on it
JobHandlerRegistry.execute skips execution when data.tenantId belongs to a suspended tenant: logs the skip and completes successfully (no retry, no DLQ); jobs without tenantId are unaffected
maintenanceJobFanout tenants enumeration excludes suspended tenants
listMarketingTenantIds excludes suspended tenants (stops sequence sends, post flips, target expiry for suspended tenants)
CE initializeScheduledJobs tenant enumeration excludes suspended tenants at registration time
Entra schedule-config loader excludes suspended tenants; Entra sync activity re-checks suspension per run
Nightly time-period chain skips creation for suspended tenants but keeps rescheduling (resumes automatically after rollback)
Billing-cycle creation excludes suspended tenants each run without terminating its schedule
Accounting sync cycle skips suspended tenants per run and keeps its reschedule chain alive
RMM polling reconciler excludes integrations of suspended tenants when enumerating rmm_integrations (cancels/never creates per-integration recurring polls)
Tactical RMM webhook acks 2xx and drops alerts for suspended tenants (debug log, no pipeline run, no event published)
NinjaOne webhook acks 2xx and drops alerts for suspended tenants after integration resolution
LevelIO webhook acks 2xx and drops alerts for suspended tenants
WorkflowRuntimeV2EventStreamWorker.processEvent acks and skips events for suspended tenants before creating any workflow run (debug log)
Event-worker suspension check fails open on flag-read errors (event processing proceeds)
ApiKeyService.validateApiKey rejects keys whose owning user is inactive
ApiKeyService.validateApiKey rejects keys whose tenant is suspended
Server-side validateApiKeyForTenant and validateApiKeyAnyTenant apply the same owner-inactive and tenant-suspended checks
/api/auth/validate-api-key reports gated keys as invalid
Anonymous appointment-request route returns a neutral 'temporarily unavailable' error for suspended tenants before persisting or emailing
Marketing capture route returns a neutral 'temporarily unavailable' error for suspended tenants; no prospect/contact/opportunity rows created
Google and Microsoft calendar webhooks ack-and-drop notifications for suspended tenants
Tenant-scoped outbound email send seam drops sends for suspended tenants with a log line; SystemEmailService paths untouched

One-off operator backfill (kept out of the repo) stamps suspended_at for tenants in pending_tenant_deletions statuses pending/awaiting_confirmation/confirmed/failed that are not yet suspended; rerunnable with per-tenant error containment
Operator backfill reports summary counts and signals failure so it can be safely rerun (validated before being moved to the private runbook)
Every gate passes non-suspended tenants through unchanged (cross-cutting regression: dispatch, fan-outs, RMM, event worker, API keys, public endpoints, outbound email)
